state.reason: Shared immutable snapshot and actual resolver result; no viewer-local winner cache.

state.denied.reason: Eligibility exclusion of first claim; production resolver must block rather than promote history.

state.status.reason: Observed none/legacy/accepted/conflict/blocked projection of shared records.

state.visible.reason: Named normalized messages/claims/resolutions supplied to the production resolver in all orders.

state.winner.reason: Observed exact referenced answer, abstracted to a bounded message symbol.

Claims.reason: History is excluded from acceptance heads and cannot displace an accepted answer.

FirstWins.reason: Safety checks later history cannot overwrite a recorded winner and offline forks remain visible.

Heads.reason: A state record supersedes only its explicitly referenced parents; unrelated offline claims survive.

Initial.reason: No evidence, no recorded acceptance; legacy replies alone do not invent a historical winner.

Missing.reason: Missing referenced parent/winner evidence blocks acceptance, with no timestamp fallback.

NeverResolved.reason: Reachability control requires an accepted choice after explicit merge of concurrent resolutions.

Next.reason: The same arrival/trust transition relation is used by TLC and actual observed trace checks.

Nodes.reason: Three roots, one history reply and its explicit owner anchor, two concurrent owner resolutions, one merge and unauthorized evidence.

Observe.reason: Arrival/reload schedule adds one immutable record; timestamp and arrival order do not arbitrate.

Parents.reason: Exact-byte parent references validated and traversed by the resolver; missing evidence blocks.

Projection.reason: Independent bounded specification of the production DAG projection and eligibility rules.

Safe.reason: Actual status/winner must equal the faithful projection, including blocked and conflict states.

Spec.reason: Bounded safety over shared-snapshot transitions; no claim of distributed online linearizability.

Step.reason: One observed arrival or trust change; repeated snapshots are permitted stuttering in trace checks.

Trust.reason: Changed local eligibility reruns projection; it cannot promote later ordinary history.

TypeOK.reason: Finite message identities, trust flag, statuses and winner symbols constrain the explored abstraction.

Winner.reason: Root self claims and author resolutions inherit an eligible claimed answer.

Winners.reason: Distinct inherited head answers expose conflict; identical concurrent choices converge.

vars.reason: All modeled shared projection fields are observed by runtime trace collectors.

models.limits: Nine named immutable records, three root answers, one ordinary history message, one explicit legacy anchor, two concurrent resolutions and one merge; one reversible eligibility flag. Crypto, parsing/hash/source binding, UI/storage writes, arbitrary graph depth and general implementation refinement remain executable tests. Equal complete snapshots plus eligibility converge; disconnected first acceptance has explicit forks, never a global lock.

state.reason: One observed record per status read of the real CLI on a real signed board.

state.ack.reason: Reviewed folder state recorded by history acknowledge for each message.

state.attention.reason: Messages whose status entry has needsAttention.

state.committed.reason: Ghost: every expectation ever observed from production; NoLostExpectation compares against it.

state.dropped.reason: Ghost: coverage the operator deliberately forgot with history forget --yes.

state.expected.reason: Messages with remembered commitments in the private path-keyed checkpoint (status entries).

state.folder.reason: Observed message bytes: original, first or second edit, or absent (regular files only).

state.pending.reason: Ghost input: listings published while unpinned; pinning later lets valid inventories count.

state.pinned.reason: Environment: signing trust/untrust of the single signer key on this client.

state.report.reason: Observed per-message state from history status (none when not expected).

state.revoked.reason: Environment: signed compromise revocation published and learned privately by status.

state.vouched.reason: Ghost input: listings published while the signer was pinned and not revoked on this client.

AckBound.reason: Acknowledged only while the folder equals the reviewed state and the source is not revoked.

Acked.reason: Acknowledgement overlay applies only while the reviewed state still matches and the source is not revoked.

Acknowledge.reason: history acknowledge records the reviewed state; refused for revoked sources.

Active.reason: Source active when pinned and not compromised (pinned-current or previously-trusted).

Additions.reason: Messages outside expectations are never reported as anomalies.

Attention.reason: needsAttention: revoked source with any non-settled state, or active source with changed bytes.

Change.reason: A writer edits message bytes (twice at most).

Consistent.reason: Recorded reports equal the faithful projection.

Delete.reason: A writer or sync removes a message.

FolderStates.reason: Exact-byte classes of a message file.

Forget.reason: history forget --yes drops coverage and leaves a tombstone.

Hidden.reason: A missing or changed expected message is never shown available unless acknowledged.

Initial.reason: Fresh client: nothing expected, signer pinned, no revocation.

Msgs.reason: One message present at start and one posted later.

NeverDetects.reason: Reachability control: a deletion must be detectable.

NoLost.reason: Expectations are never lost except by explicit forget.

NoLostExpectation.reason: Named safety invariant (bad variants ResetOnSharedRemoval, ReplayReplacesCheckpoint).

Observe.reason: history observe lists current unchanged messages; only a pinned current key creates expectations.

Post.reason: A new message appears in the folder (addition).

PostRecorded.reason: boardctl post with room_history on-post: publish first, then the unchanged observe with the poster's key only when it is pinned and current and no anomaly exists; otherwise the post stands alone.

Project.reason: Every step recomputes reports from current inputs, like each status run.

RemoveShared.reason: Shared history folder removed; private expectations must survive.

Rep.reason: Observed-state projection of folder, expectations, acknowledgement and revocation.

Repin.reason: signing trust; pending valid inventories may now count.

Replay.reason: Older shared inventory copy replayed; expectations must not shrink.

Reports.reason: Observed states modelled; sidecar and conflict states are unit-tested.

Restore.reason: Original bytes return (backup or delayed sync).

Revoked.reason: Per-key status checks learned compromise before pins (UnpinShadowsRevocation reverses it).

RevokedAttention.reason: Revoked sources always need attention when not settled.

Safe.reason: All safety predicates; used for trace conformance.

Start.reason: Initial folder: first message present, second not yet posted.

Step.reason: The transition relation shared by TLC and observed production traces.

models.limits: Two messages and one signer key. Sidecar loss, conflicting commitments, multiple sources, flooding budgets, capacity and format validation are covered by unit tests, not this model. Bounded sampled traces, not a refinement proof; cryptography and filesystem atomicity are outside the model.

models.review: 2026-11-03 (SPEC-002-079): New hand-written bounded model of sub-threads (convention 3.4.1). Reviewed against boardctl subthread_check, check_message, command_post, command_promote, next_thread, message_order, subthread_warnings, validate_report, subthread_summaries, command_recent and answer_workflow.scan. The collector runs the real commands on two board copies and a shared folder; three positive traces conform and eight implementation mutants are rejected by TraceConforms. Acceptance reuses AnswerAcceptance!Projection as a contract (S8), not composed behaviours; AnswerAcceptance.tla is unchanged. The fixed refusal order is a symmetry reduction: a refusal writes nothing. Faithful TLC: 65,043 distinct states. Refined repair rule (decision #37) in message_repairs.subthread_header_issue is outside the model (unit-tested, pinned in cases.json); MESSAGE_REF_RE now lives in message_repairs and boardctl aliases it.

state.reason: One record per observed step: two board copies, a shared folder and the production reads of the changed copy.

state.accept.reason: answers inspect status and winner for each question present and valid in the copy.

state.board.reason: Files in the shared folder, mirrored from each writer's own copy (deletions included).

state.claims.reason: Posted answers whose file carries the first ANSWER-STATE claim, as post decided from the writer's own copy.

state.intact.reason: Every file in every copy and the shared folder has the bytes it was written with.

state.main.reason: recent --main-flow rows: non-members plus SUBTHREAD-ALSO members.

state.members.reason: recent rows whose subthread field is the root: explicit SUBTHREAD only.

state.phase.reason: Progress of promote: idle, after the first write (observed between its two command_post calls), failed or done.

state.posted.reason: Files a real post or promote reported as written (ghost: kept even if a defective promote deletes one).

state.refused.reason: Attempts post refused with exit 2 before writing; the unmarked answer is refused by subthread_check(new_post=True).

state.state.reason: recent --subthreads state of the root, or none when it has no valid eligible member.

state.valid.reason: Files of the copy without a validate_report error.

state.view.reason: Message files present in each participant's copy; arrival is a copy from the shared folder.

state.warned.reason: Files named by a validate warning: orphaned members and displaced PROMOTED-FROM first messages.

AA.reason: Operator reuse of AnswerAcceptance!Projection for the S8 contract; no composed behaviours.

Accept.reason: Acceptance of a question in a copy, used by post to decide the first claim.

AcceptBlind.reason: Marker-blind reference: every valid answer to the question.

AcceptIn.reason: Valid answers to a question; AcceptIgnoresMembers drops members.

AcceptOf.reason: Acceptance over a computed valid set; none when the question is absent or invalid.

Acceptance.reason: Maps answers to AnswerAcceptance nodes (claim a/b, history h) and back.

Answers.reason: Answer candidates: main by default, joined, member and unmarked.

AttemptOrder.reason: Fixed order of the four refusals; a refusal writes nothing (symmetry reduction).

Author.reason: Writer of each candidate: alpha-agent is w1, bravo-agent is w2.

Bad.reason: Candidates post must refuse: early, nested, outside and unmarked.

Consistent.reason: Observed per-copy projections equal the faithful ones.

Deliver.reason: One accepted file reaches the other copy, in any order.

DepsIn.reason: REPLY-TO target and PROMOTED-FROM origin present: the generic rules a file needs to be valid.

EarlierSibling.reason: Another message of the same topic earlier in canonical order.

HandFirstRefused.reason: A hand-written PROMOTED-FROM post refused because the topic already has a message in the copy.

Initial.reason: Empty copies, shared folder and observations; promote idle.

MainIn.reason: Main flow of a copy: non-members and also-in-main members.

MarkerOk.reason: An answer to a member question carries that sub-thread's marker.

Members.reason: Members of the root in a copy.

MembersIn.reason: Explicit membership; InheritMembership adds plain replies to members.

Need.reason: Files a writer has before it posts: reply target, root, origin (environment assumption).

NestOk.reason: The root is not a member (one level).

NeverAllWitnessed.reason: Reachability witness: one state shows every property positively.

NewState.reason: Reader state: recomputed from the visible set; LastArrival keeps the last arrival.

Next.reason: The same transition relation TLC explores and the trace bridge checks.

NoAcceptance.reason: Constant state for the AnswerAcceptance instance; only its Projection is used.

Node.reason: First claim (a, or b for the joined answer) or history (h).

None.reason: No acceptance: status none, winner none.

ObservationsConsistent.reason: Named consistency invariant of the faithful configuration.

Post.reason: An ordinary post from the writer's copy: accepted with the claim decision, or refused.

PostOk.reason: The rule set plus post-time rules: member after root, PROMOTED-FROM only into an empty topic.

PromoteFails.reason: The second write fails; nothing is deleted (PromoteDeletes removes the first).

PromoteFirst.reason: First write: allocates a free thread number in its copy, then PROMOTED-FROM.

Question.reason: The question each answer replies to.

Questions.reason: The root question and the member question.

Rank.reason: Canonical posting order (DATE instant, POSTED-AT, filename) the collector fixes with --at; z and s2 tie on DATE/POSTED-AT.

Refresh.reason: Recomputes the observations of the one copy a step changed.

ReplyOk.reason: A member replies to the root or a member of the same sub-thread.

S2.reason: No board has a member whose root is a member.

S3.reason: Every member on the board replies inside its sub-thread.

S4.reason: State is a function of the visible set; equal sets agree.

S5.reason: An accepted message stays valid wherever what it references is present.

S6.reason: Nothing deleted or modified; the new topic is valid and in the main flow.

S7.reason: Answers join their question's sub-thread; a root question's answer joins only explicitly.

Safe.reason: Typing, consistency and S1-S8; checked on every trace state.

StateIn.reason: Latest SUBTHREAD-STATE by canonical order over valid members; default open.

StaticOk.reason: The one rule helper used by post and validate; each mutation disables one rule.

Step.reason: Post, deliver or one of promote's steps; trace steps must be one of these or stutter.

Valid.reason: Validity of an existing file; FirstIsError makes a displaced first message an error.

WarnedIn.reason: Orphaned members and valid displaced PROMOTED-FROM messages.

Writers.reason: Two participants that both write and read their own copy.

models.limits: One room with two topics, one root with a sub-thread, two writers and fourteen fixed candidates (ten accepted, four refused). Signing eligibility, repair quarantine, direct pairs, header value syntax and exact wording are covered by tests/test_subthreads.py and tests/fixtures/subthreads/cases.json, not modelled. Bounded sampled traces, not a refinement proof.
